notification.turn_failed: Request failed. Check the terminal for details.
notification.turn_incomplete: Response incomplete. Check the terminal before continuing.

completion.description: Choose how suggestions appear and which key accepts them.
completion.details: Inline: Tab accepts the suggestion after the cursor. List: candidates appear as you type; use arrow keys to select and Tab to insert. Hybrid: Right arrow accepts the inline suggestion; Tab opens the list, arrow keys select and Enter inserts. Escape closes the list. Accepting a suggestion never runs the command. Changes apply to open terminals.

environment.refresh: Refresh system environment for new terminals
environment.refresh_description: Read current Windows environment settings when opening a terminal. Turn off to inherit the environment used to launch Pebrel, including temporary PATH entries. Open terminals are unchanged.

cursor_motion.title: Smooth cursor
cursor_motion.description: Animate terminal cursor movement; large jumps remain instant.

scrolling.history_description: History lines retained per terminal. Applies to new terminals only.
scrolling.speed_description: Mouse wheel multiplier. Takes effect immediately; trackpad scrolling is unchanged.

notifications.duration_description: Choose when in-app notifications close, or keep them until dismissed.
notifications.duration_details: Applies to new or refreshed in-app cards. Defaults: short toasts 5 seconds, banners 90 seconds, update notices until dismissed. Only the latest three cards are kept, including in persistent mode. Closing or replacing a card never answers a confirmation or changes task state. System notifications are unchanged.
notifications.ai_messages_description: Show AI toasts in the lower-right corner. System notifications are unaffected.
notifications.ai_messages_details: Turning this off dismisses existing in-app AI toasts and hides new completion and confirmation toasts. System notifications, including Windows notifications, and tab status indicators are unchanged. Terminal output and confirmation requests in the terminal remain available.
notifications.save_failed: Could not save the notification setting: {error}

terminal.label: System proxy
terminal.description: When enabled, new terminals use the current Windows system proxy. A custom proxy address is applied to new terminals on its own, without this switch.
